As you know, the v1 API is currently targeted for retirement on September 30, and the v2 replacement is available and has passed the documented compatibility tests. Before I make the final call and record the commitments for the release program, I need to walk through the plan with both API platform and customer success as part of our normal release-readiness process. Can we go through any remaining considerations from your sides?
